caption:
Which element is the bossiest? 📋

In Chinese astrology your element comes from the day you were born. The five yang elements lead from the front: Yang Metal sets the deadlines, Yang Fire runs the show, Yang Wood hands out the jobs. Bossy, yes, but the plan does happen.
